text: BRAINSTORM (worlds, 2 providers, converged). Verdict: 'worlds'=vocabulary+LOD contract, NOT heavy nesting. Bound to 2 levels (plan-region ⊃ {spec,plan,task}; subtasks+steps=bounded interior). Zoom=SELECTOR (swaps §18 mode), not stretcher. Banded Multi-Column Sweep: band by primary section, bounded cols, wrap sub-rows, top-down non-overlap sweep, super-cells for subtasks, steps=interior height → 19 tasks become a few-hundred-px grid. Spec=paged doc-world + section RAIL (chunk-worlds when extreme). Drill=in-place zoom + reversible camera-focus + breadcrumb, never modal. Synthesized → design §20.

ANDREY VISUAL FEEDBACK (STEP 1 board): (1) task layout still bad — grows straight DOWN as one tall column; banded multi-column is the fix and is PRIORITY #1 (band each task next to its section's rail OUTPUT). (2) Couldn't see section→task connections because tasks are a far column — banded resolves this; spec is now the section BODIES inside the ONE node (§22.2 merge, correct). (3) Internal scroll idea APPROVED, but must be DISTANCE-GATED (§23.6): far = wheel pans canvas (no intercept), near/focused (camera>~1.0) = wheel scrolls node content, release at boundary, don't annoy. Iterate: STEP2 banded → screenshot+review → STEP3 + scroll-gating.

STEP 2 review (orchestrator): banded produces 3 cols + step text in Document + scroll-gating, tests green. BUT world still ~20000px tall → fit-all 5%, not visually reviewable. Likely bug: plan-node Document height not truly fixed at 640 OR task field spans huge Y range instead of hugging fixed rail outputs. Directed FE: (a) bound world height + add Playwright height assert, (b) STEP 3 default-focus@90% (prereq for any readable view). Then real visual review.
